name: TEMPO-2
fullName: Tenecteplase versus Standard of Care for Minor Ischaemic Stroke with Proven Occlusion (TEMPO-2)
teachingPoint: Argues against routine thrombolysis for minor non-disabling stroke solely because an occlusion is present; keep the disabling-deficit gate.

name: ARAMIS
fullName: Dual Antiplatelet Therapy vs Alteplase for Patients With Minor Nondisabling Acute Ischemic Stroke
population: n=760, median 64 (IQR 57-71); 31.0% women, NIHSS NIHSS ≤5, with ≤1 point on key single items (median 2), ≤4.5 h
teachingPoint: For genuinely non-disabling minor stroke within 4.5 h, DAPT is a reasonable alternative to IV thrombolysis.
